title: What Space Elevator Climbers 2.0 Is
definition: Space Elevator Climbers 2.0: next-gen climbers for space elevator ribbons.
description:
Space Elevator Climbers 2.0: next-gen climbers for space elevator ribbons. This is Future Transport & Mobility at its most ambitious — ribbon grips research, climber logistics engineering and power beaming operations converging on a single goal: making climber hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Transport & Mobility will decide counterweight ops outcomes this century. Space Elevator Climbers 2.0 is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working climber hulls, the larger ribbon grips vision stalls, and with it, the climber logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Space Elevator Climbers 2.0 in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Space Elevator Climbers 2.0
title: Real Research Today: Space Elevator Climbers 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Space Elevator Climbers 2.0.
description:
The road to Space Elevator Climbers 2.0 is already being paved. The eVTOL industry (Joby, Archer, Lilium) certifies electric air taxis with aviation authorities. NASA's X-59 QueSST and Boom Supersonic's XB-1 pursue quiet supersonic flight.

Maglev lines (Shanghai, JR Tokai's Chuo Shinkansen) run revenue service above 400 km/h. Together these programs form the ribbon grips foundation that Space Elevator Climbers 2.0 will build on — the climber logistics results, the power beaming methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as climber logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed ribbon grips demonstrations, climber logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting power beaming uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Space Elevator Climbers 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Space Elevator Climbers 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Space Elevator Climbers 2.0 — next-gen climbers for space elevator ribbons.

Phase 1 — Prove (ribbon grips): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (climber logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (power beaming): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (counterweight ops): climber hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and orbit-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
